title: FRONT & REAR BRAKE CALIPER ASM.
summary: Front and rear disc brake calipers (LH/RH). Each front caliper bolts to the steering knuckle behind the rotor, next to the splash shield, with two bolts and lock washers; each rear caliper bolts to the rear wheel spindle, arm & bracket assembly (trailing arm) with two bolts and lock washers. Bleeder screws are retorqued after bleeding.

fastening.to: front steering knuckle (not labeled), beside the splash shield
fastening.note: Front wheel view: two bolts [3] with lock washers [2] go in from the inboard side through the knuckle into the caliper mounting ears (upper and lower).

fastening.to: rear wheel spindle, arm & bracket assembly (trailing arm)
fastening.note: Rear wheel view: two bolts [5] with lock washers [2] go in from the inboard side through the bracket into the caliper.

notes: Retorque [bleeder screw] to 40-90 lbs in after bleeding hydraulic brake system. (View A)
notes_internal: Item 1: binder hole covers digits 3-6: '54????6-7' (OCR '54' + '66-7'; 6th digit partially visible).
Torque 2 value read as 60-80 (zoomed; OCR agrees); torque 1 60-90. Revision 1 says bolt [3] WAS torque 1, so bolts now use torque 2.
Rear view also has a 'PORT' label pointing at the caliper inlet. Triangles 3-5 blank; 'K177' printed vertically.
